summary: When someone speaks to Nora in a Discord voice channel, she is now told the message was spoken and that her reply will be heard aloud, not read.
details: The note is added only on spoken turns, next to the message it describes; typed messages are unchanged.
It states the situation and leaves the consequences to her: a reply meant for a voice should not lean on links, lists or long text.
limitations: Not yet measured on an eval: no eval case is spoken today.
Her standing guidance still describes chat typing in places; that text is unchanged here.
